name: Utakata no Tsubomi
source:
Kotaro Izaki, the protagonist who returns home at his older sister's request.

Kyoko Miura, the recently widowed older sister who is terribly lonely.

Expressionless and standoffish since childhood, an old classmate named Miyuki.

Tomoe, the defiant blonde bad girl.

These four players form a homecoming story around Kotaro,
spurring days of lewdness......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123356.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公伊崎晃太郎应姐姐的请求回到故乡。

三浦京子，刚刚失去丈夫、十分孤独的姐姐。

从小就面无表情、态度冷淡的老同学美雪。

还有桀骜不驯的金发不良少女朋江。

这四个人围绕晃太郎组成了一段返乡故事，
由此展开了放荡的日子……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123356.html]DLsite English[/url]]
